name: list_project_domains
description:
List the domains attached to a project, identified by ID or name. Supports filtering by target, production, redirect, verification status, git branch, or custom environment, plus pagination with limit (max 100), since, until, and order.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v9/projects/{idOrName}/domains --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

customEnvironmentId.description: The unique custom environment identifier within the project

gitBranch.description: Filters domains based on specific branch.

idOrName.description: The unique project identifier or the project name

limit.description: Maximum number of domains to list from a request (max 100).

production.description: Filters only production domains when set to `true`.

redirect.description: Filters domains based on their redirect target.

redirects.description: Excludes redirect project domains when "false". Includes redirect project domains when "true" (default).

since.description: Get domains created after this JavaScript timestamp.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

target.description: Filters on the target of the domain. Can be either "production", "preview"

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

until.description: Get domains created before this JavaScript timestamp.

verified.description: Filters domains based on their verification status.
